title: Subjectifying the Personality State: Theoretical Underpinnings and an Empirical Example
limitations: - Small sample size; - Limited generalizability due to non-clinical sample; - No formal preregistration; - Network stability and accuracy issues in intraindividual models
notes: The study used a non-clinical sample (undergraduates) despite focusing on clinical models. The authors did not preregister hypotheses, but code and data are available. Intraindividual networks showed lower stability compared to group-level networks.
